ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels and 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly white background on both lobes. The left lobe contains scattered, discrete low-intensity black circular blobs (mottling). The right lobe features a large, contiguous low-intensity dark region extending from the median notch, with smaller black spots distributed toward the distal edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with an approximate vertex angle of 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration; the left trailing edge exhibits small, sharp peaks, while the right trailing edge shows deeper, more pronounced valleys near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature with lobes tapering to sharp, slightly upward-curved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small black pixel clusters (dots) distributed across both lobes; a dense cluster of yellowish-white raised pixels is visible at the far right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A few short, low-intensity linear marks are visible on the inner right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Yellowish-brown encrustation and irregular pixel texture on the far right fluke tip, indicative of barnacle colonization or localized scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'stippling' pattern of black spots concentrated on the outer distal margins of both the left and right lobes.
